bioconda.name: fastnlr
bioconda.summary: Fast, accurate NLR immune-receptor locus annotation for plant genomes.
bioconda.description:
FastNLR scans the six reading frames of an assembled plant genome for
amino-acid motifs and assembles complete and partial NLR loci. It is
implemented in Rust and provides multithreaded scanning, memory-mapped
FASTA input, checkpoint resume, and multi-format output.
